package main

import "os"

func main() { os.Exit(run()) }
-- db/db.go --
package db

type DB struct{}

//fabrik:provider
func NewDB() (*DB, func() error, error) {
	return &DB{}, func() error { return nil }, nil
}
-- shared/shared.go --
package shared

import (
	"app/db"
	"app/store"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"
)

//fabrik:provider:select store.kind
type Selected = store.Store

//fabrik:cli:command
func Ping(ctx cli.Context, d *db.DB, s Selected) error { return nil }
-- store/store.go --
package store

//fabrik:config store
type Config struct {
	Kind string `yaml:"kind" default:"sqlite"`
}

type Store interface {
	Get(k string) string
}

type Sqlite struct{}

func (Sqlite) Get(string) string { return "" }

//fabrik:provider case=sqlite
func NewSqlite(c *Config) (Sqlite, error) { return Sqlite{}, nil }
-- want/main.gen.go --
// Code generated by fabrik. DO NOT EDIT.
// Regenerate with: fabrik wire

package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"

	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/cli"
	"github.com/gofabrik/fabrik/config"

	"app/db"
	"app/shared"
	"app/store"
)

func run() int {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	defer cancel()
	sigc := make(chan os.Signal, 2)
	signal.Notify(sigc, os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer signal.Stop(sigc)
	go func() {
		<-sigc
		cancel()
		<-sigc
		os.Exit(1)
	}()

	root := &cli.Command{
		Name: "app",
		Subcommands: []*cli.Command{
			{
				Name: "ping",
				Run: func(ctx cli.Context) (err error) {
					db2, store2, cleanup, err := buildPing(ctx)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					defer func() {
						err = errors.Join(err, cleanup())
					}()
					return shared.Ping(ctx, db2, store2)
				},
			},
		},
	}
	return root.Exec(os.Args[1:], cli.WithSignalContext(ctx))
}

func buildPing(ctx context.Context) (*db.DB, shared.Selected, func() error, error) {
	var err error
	// Config
	fabrikEnv := os.Getenv("FABRIK_ENV")
	switch fabrikEnv {
	case "development", "production":
	default:
		if fabrikEnv == "" {
			err = fmt.Errorf("FABRIK_ENV is required: development or production")
		} else {
			err = fmt.Errorf("invalid FABRIK_ENV %q: want development or production", fabrikEnv)
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}
	fabrikConfigOpts := []config.Option{
		config.FileOptional("config.yaml"),
		config.File("config." + fabrikEnv + ".yaml"),
	}
	if fabrikEnv == "development" {
		fabrikConfigOpts = append(fabrikConfigOpts, config.FileOptional("config.local.yaml"))
	}
	storeConfig, err := config.Load[store.Config](append(fabrikConfigOpts,
		config.KnownSections("store"),
		config.Section("store"),
	)...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}

	// Providers
	dbDB, dbDBClose, err := db.NewDB()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}

	// shared.Selected, selected by store.kind
	var storeStore shared.Selected
	switch storeConfig.Kind {
	case "sqlite":
		storeStoreSqlite, err := store.NewSqlite(storeConfig)
		if err != nil {
			if dbDBClose != nil {
				err = errors.Join(err, dbDBClose())
			}
			return nil, nil, nil, err
		}
		storeStore = storeStoreSqlite
	default:
		err = fmt.Errorf("no shared.Selected implementation for %q", storeConfig.Kind)
		if dbDBClose != nil {
			err = errors.Join(err, dbDBClose())
		}
		return nil, nil, nil, err
	}

	cleanup := func() error {
		var errs []error
		if dbDBClose != nil {
			errs = append(errs, dbDBClose())
		}
		return errors.Join(errs...)
	}
	return dbDB, storeStore, cleanup, nil
}
